packageRules.description: The linter is the one module in tools/go.mod that was chosen, and a tool directive leaves it marked indirect like everything it pulls in. Named in full, its module path makes a subject longer than the 72 characters allowed.
Newer releases ask for Go 1.26, and go.mod holds the Go 1.24 floor a source install builds on. Lift these with that floor.
Newer releases ask for Go 1.26, through modernc.org/libc; see the rule above.
Everything arrives together, minors in one pull request and majors in another.
